note: Majority: not read. The Faroese guardianship order (Bekendtgørelse for Færøerne om værgemål, BEK nr 453 af 28/04/2010) was found by name on Retsinformation, which doesn't show its text (it points to Lovtidende A, whose search didn't answer this client); logir.fo's search form returned only its blank form; null. Work: no Faroese text on young people's work was read (logir.fo's search, and a web search in Faroese, found none); null. Service: Denmark's Værnepligtsloven (consolidated by LBK nr 225 af 13/03/2006, amended to LOV nr 715 af 20/06/2025, which from 2026 extends the duty to women), § 5: 'the country' in the Act means the Kingdom of Denmark except the Faroe Islands and Greenland; § 13: conscripts resident or staying in the country must attend Forsvarets Dag in the year they turn eighteen; § 1 stk. 3: someone who moves to Denmark from the Faroes or Greenland after living there at least ten years may be exempted. So a person living in the Faroe Islands isn't called (my reading of §§ 5 and 13 together): none.

sources.title: Retsinformation: Bekendtgørelse af værnepligtsloven (LBK nr 225 af 13/03/2006, as amended to LOV nr 715 af 20/06/2025)
sources.said: Den, der er tilflyttet fra Færøerne eller Grønland efter at have haft ophold der i mindst 10 år, kan af forsvarsministeren eller den myndighed, forsvarsministeren bemyndiger til det, fritages for værnepligt. ... Ved udtrykket »landet« forstås i denne lov Kongeriget Danmark med undtagelse af Færøerne og Grønland. ... Værnepligtige, der har bopæl eller ophold her i landet, skal møde til Forsvarets Dag i det år, hvori de fylder 18 år.
